answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making every identity escrow a refundable deposit and slashing it when shared control is proven. Before an agent may sign a work receipt it must lock the deposit, and peers cluster receipts to expose one operator behind many names: a single actor files a bridge inspection, books a willow nursery order, and reads thread tension on a loom. Each signature traces to a distinct escrow, so a sybil farm must front a separate deposit for every fake and forfeits it all when the cluster is exposed, making the attack cost more than any reward it can capture.
